summary: Iteration 3 - Groveno Fresh CL Panel. Backend: 103/103 pytest pass (65 iter1 + 15 iter2 referral/SSE + 23 new CL panel). All 4 new CL endpoints working correctly: GET /api/cl/me (with 401 on missing/admin/customer tokens), PUT /api/cl/profile (bankDetails persistence + partial merge), POST /api/cl/change-password (wrong old->400, short new->400, valid flow with re-login, revert), GET /api/cl/earnings (summary math + commissionRate=0.05 + history array). Regression: cl login, /api/cl/dashboard, /api/orders/cl-order and /api/cl/orders/:id/deliver still work; commission credited on delivery; idempotent on double-deliver. Frontend: full E2E walk of all 8 CL pages on 480x900 mobile viewport. CL Login prefill + wrong-password toast + successful login stores 'groveno_cl_token' + redirects to /cl/dashboard. Protected route /cl/dashboard redirects to /cl/login when no token. Bottom nav navigates to all 5 tabs (dashboard/orders/earnings/qr/profile). Dashboard shows all 4 stat cards. Orders page: 3 filter tabs, search input, bulk button work; clicking an order link navigates to /cl/orders/:id. Bulk order page: heading 'Place Order for My Community', customer-0 form, add-customer appends customer-1. Order Detail: shows masked phone '91XXX22333' correctly. QR page: api.qrserver.com image loads, CL code 'CL12345', copy/download/whatsapp buttons, scan analytics visible. Earnings page: balance card + 3 mini stats + withdraw btn disabled. Profile: cl-profile-code shows 'CL12345', bank fields update and PERSIST after PUT /api/cl/profile (verified via reload). Logout clears token and redirects to /cl/login. Admin panel regression: /login -> /dashboard works with admin@groveno.com/Admin@123, 10 sidebar nav items intact, no CL leakage. CL password reverted to CL@123 at end of run (verified by explicit final login test).

minor.issue: Response returns Mongoose document with raw '_id', '__v' fields alongside virtual 'id' (from toJSON override). Not a bug, but consumers should treat both as valid id sources. This is consistent with rest of API (pre-existing pattern from iter 1).
Endpoint does not validate email format or IFSC format server-side. If frontend passes an invalid email, it will be lowercased and saved as-is. Consider adding format validators.

issues: Non-critical console warnings persist: React Router future flag warnings (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) — carry-over from iter 2, not blocking.

Toasts (react-hot-toast) stack in top-right and can briefly overlap the primary submit button on very short viewports; playwright had one intermittent click miss on cl-btn-bulk immediately after login toast. Resolved by waiting ~1.5s for toast to fade. Consider auto-dismissing 'Welcome back!' faster or placing toasts under the header.

action_items: None blocking — all requested features work end-to-end.
Optional: add server-side format validation for email and IFSC in PUT /api/cl/profile.
Optional: shorten 'Welcome back!' toast duration or move to bottom to avoid overlapping header/submit buttons on narrow viewports.
critical_code_review_comments: cl.controller.js:updateProfile: uses `bankDetails.accountHolder ?? req.cl.bankDetails?.accountHolder ?? ''` — good merge semantics. However there is no way to clear a bank field explicitly (setting to '' works, but sending null falls back to existing). Acceptable trade-off.

cl.controller.js:earnings computes startOfWeek using now.getDay() (Sunday=0). In India most week views start on Monday. Verify with product before shipping — currently 'thisWeek' rolls over on Sunday midnight local server time.
CLOrderDetail.jsx fetches all orders via GET /cl/orders?limit=200 and then finds by id client-side. Not a bug at current scale but O(N) and wasteful. Consider adding GET /api/cl/orders/:id.
CLQrCode.jsx computes 'ordersFromQR' as `stats.totalOrders` — this is TOTAL orders, not orders from QR specifically. Label is misleading. Suggest a separate counter or rename UI to 'Total Orders'.
CommunityLeader.toJSON drops passwordHash but still exposes __v and _id. Add a global toJSON transform for consistency (carry-over from iter 1 minor).

success_rate.frontend: 100% for tested CL flows (login/logout/protected, dashboard, orders+filter+search, order detail with phone masking, bulk order + add customer, earnings, QR, profile save persistence) + admin regression
